info.title: OnDemand Spatial Active Fire Search (NASA FIRMS)
info.description: Search near-real-time satellite active fire detections from NASA FIRMS (LANCE NRT) by geographic area — bounding box or circle (lat + lon + radius_km) — and time window (1–10 days back or specific start date). Returns observed hotspot detections (latitude, longitude, brightness temperature, fire radiative power MW, confidence, acquisition timestamp, satellite instrument, day/night) and provenance metadata. Sourced from VIIRS (NOAA-20, NOAA-21, Suomi-NPP) and MODIS instruments. Requires NASA_FIRMS_MAP_KEY (or FIRMS_MAP_KEY) on the deployment; answers honest 503 `not_configured` when absent. Detections capped at 200 per call.

conversationStarters: Are there any active fire detections near Los Angeles (lat 34.05, lon -118.25) in the last 2 days?
Search active fires in the Texas Panhandle box -103,34,-100,36 for today
List high-confidence fire hotspots around Athens, Greece within 100 km

x-ondemand-spatial.auth: none — same-origin proxy; upstream credentials stay server-side

get.summary: Search NASA FIRMS active fire hotspots by bounding box or circle and time range
get.description: Queries NASA FIRMS active fire detections by bounding box (bbox="west,south,east,north") or circle (latitude + longitude + radius_km, all three required together). Supports day_range (1–10 days back, default 1), specific start date (YYYY-MM-DD), source satellite instrument (VIIRS_NOAA20_NRT, VIIRS_NOAA21_NRT, VIIRS_SNPP_NRT, MODIS_NRT), optional min_confidence filter (low, nominal, high), and limit (1–200, default 100). Returns normalised hotspot events with observed coordinates, brightness Kelvin, FRP (MW), confidence, satellite, and acquisition time. Requires server NASA_FIRMS_MAP_KEY; answers 503 `not_configured` without it.

parameters.name: bbox
parameters.description: Bounding box as "west,south,east,north" in decimal degrees (WGS84). Exclusive with circle parameters.

parameters.name: latitude
parameters.description: Circle-search centre latitude in decimal degrees. Requires longitude and radius_km together.

parameters.name: longitude
parameters.description: Circle-search centre longitude in decimal degrees. Requires latitude and radius_km together.

parameters.name: radius_km
parameters.description: Circle-search radius in kilometres (1–1000). Requires latitude and longitude together.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: FIRMS satellite sensor product. Default VIIRS_NOAA20_NRT.

parameters.name: day_range
parameters.description: Number of days to search back (1–10). Default 1 (current UTC day).

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Optional start date in YYYY-MM-DD format (UTC). If omitted, searches backwards from now.

parameters.name: min_confidence
parameters.description: Minimum detection confidence filter: "low", "nominal", or "high". Optional.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of fire detections to return (1–200). Default 100.

502.description: Upstream failure with a structured reason

503.description: Provider unavailable (missing key / no data) with a structured reason
